title: Playing Atari with Deep Reinforcement Learning

beats.text: Feeding raw video game pixels into a neural network used to trigger immediate mathematical chaos.
beats.visual_focus: Chalkboard showing an Atari Space Invaders screen feeding pixel matrices into a neural net that instantly diverges with red warning flashes.

visual_blueprint.title: DIRECT PIXEL FEED
visual_blueprint.sub: Raw frame tensors feeding directly into value head

motif_params.title: DIRECT PIXEL FEED
motif_params.sub: Raw frame tensors feeding directly into value head

beats.text: Standard reinforcement learning demands independent samples. Sequential game frames are tightly correlated. Training on live gameplay causes the weights to catastrophically diverge.
beats.visual_focus: A filmstrip of nearly identical consecutive Pong frames showing correlated gradients compounding into runaway weight explosions.

visual_blueprint.title: TEMPORAL FEEDBACK LOOP
visual_blueprint.sub: Correlated state transitions destabilize Q-value gradient descent

motif_params.title: TEMPORAL FEEDBACK LOOP
motif_params.sub: Correlated state transitions destabilize Q-value gradient descent

beats.text: DeepMind broke the vicious cycle with Experience Replay. Instead of learning live. The agent records every state transition into a massive circular buffer.
beats.visual_focus: A circular ring buffer capturing gameplay transitions: state, action, reward, next state, stacking them into an indexed replay bank.

beats.text: A convolutional network samples random mini-batches from memory. Shuffling past experiences breaks temporal correlation. Stabilizing gradient updates directly from raw pixels.
beats.visual_focus: Arrows drawing randomized, non-consecutive frames from the buffer and feeding them into convolutional layers to compute Bellman error.

beats.text: Zero architecture tweaks. The exact same model crushed previous methods across six classic Atari games and defeated human experts on three.
beats.visual_focus: Side-by-side performance chart showing Breakout, Pong, and Space Invaders score bars rocketing past human baseline benchmarks.
